baselineReassignment.reason: In the pinned baseline the 5th carried OSM ways w284933769 and w284933770, the short course's 4th and 5th fairways, 29-51 m clear of its line: reconcile gave any OSM fairway to the hole whose line its centroid lay within 70 m of. Reconcile now requires the hole's line to run through the polygon, so those strips are short-course scenery and the pre-review geometry this review replaces is the club-plan reading.

features.note: Visible boundary of the short-mown, striped fairway against the paler rough, followed by eye on the native 0.16 m panel (a global contrast stretch and a smoothness/excess-green false-colour rendering of the same pixels were viewing aids only; no classification was adopted). Runs from the diagonally striped approach between the two greenside bunkers, overlapping the front of the putting surface rather than asserting a boundary through it, down to the rounded forward end above the tee path. The two left-side fairway bunkers, the right-side bunker and the left greenside bunker stay outside on their own mown collars. Replaces the club-plan reading, which spanned the rough to the treeline; the OSM strips once assigned here (w284933769, w284933770) are the short course's 4th and 5th.
